programmes.university: Concordia University (John Molson School of Business)

requirements.gpa: Minimum B (or equivalent) (JMSB admissions, via search summary)
requirements.gre_gmat: GMAT 49th percentile or higher; equivalent GRE may be accepted; waiver possible for Canadian-educated applicants
requirements.work_experience: At least 2 years full-time post-bachelor's experience (internships/co-ops/part-time do not count)

programmes.notes: Official Concordia ISO estimate letter (start 11 Jan 2027): first year CAD 33,795.40, full 2-year programme CAD 62,902.75 at the international rate, including student, admin and international health insurance fees. Personal expenses CAD 8,205.66/term x 3 = CAD 24,616.98/year. Requirements from search summaries of JMSB pages, not opened directly. Quebec: CAQ required; Quebec proof-of-funds rules differ. 24 months: spouse eligible for open work permit (16+ month master's).

living_cost.basis: Budget = IRCC minimum proof of funds for a single student outside Quebec, CAD 23,448/year (applications on/after 1 Sept 2026) / 12. Moderate (estimate) = Concordia ISO personal-expense estimate CAD 8,205.66/term x 3 terms / 12 (Montreal; off-campus housing, books, local transport, misc). Comfortable (estimate) = Ivey MBA monthly estimates with a one-bedroom apartment (London ON: rent 1,450 + utilities 100 + food 500 + phone 80 + misc 425 + insurance 18). Toronto and Vancouver rents are typically higher than these; no official Toronto/Vancouver figure was captured.

proof_of_funds.text: Single student outside Quebec must show CAD 23,448 per year for living costs, on top of first-year tuition and transport, for applications submitted on or after 1 September 2026. Quebec programmes follow Quebec's own amounts (CAQ). A GIC is an accepted form of proof in the regular stream.

work_during_study.text: Off-campus work up to 24 hours per week during academic sessions; unlimited hours during scheduled breaks (summer/winter holidays, reading week). If the programme has no scheduled breaks, the 24-hour limit still applies. IRCC June 2026 guidance: no on- or off-campus work during any leave from studies.

post_study_work.name: Post-Graduation Work Permit (PGWP), open work permit
post_study_work.text: Master's graduates can get a 3-year PGWP even if the master's was under 2 years, provided the programme is at least 8 months at a PGWP-eligible DLI with full-time status. No field-of-study requirement for bachelor's/master's/doctoral graduates. Language requirement: CLB 7 (English) or NCLC 7 (French) in all 4 skills for university graduates. Apply within 180 days of completion. Permit cannot exceed passport validity. Work permit fee CAD 155 + open work permit holder fee CAD 100 (IRCC fee list).

pr_pathway.text: Express Entry, Canadian Experience Class: at least 1 year (1,560 hours, 30 h/week) of paid skilled work in Canada (TEER 0-3) in the 3 years before applying, plus an approved language test meeting minimums in all 4 abilities. Work done while a full-time student, including co-op terms, does not count, so the PGWP years are what build CEC eligibility. Selection is by competitive Express Entry draws (CRS cut-offs not captured here).

recent_changes.title: 2026 study permit cap: up to 408,000 permits (155,000 new arrivals), 7% below 2025
recent_changes.who_affected: All new study permit applicants subject to the cap (PAL/TAL cohort: up to 180,000 permits, 309,670 application spaces; Ontario 104,780)
recent_changes.impact: Fewer seats overall and province-controlled allocations; Ontario says it prioritises labour-market-aligned (e.g. STEM) programmes. Master's students at public universities are exempt from the PAL/TAL (see next item), so direct impact on a master's applicant is limited.

recent_changes.title: Master's and doctoral students at public DLIs no longer need a PAL/TAL
recent_changes.who_affected: Students in degree-granting master's or doctoral programmes at public DLIs starting 1 Jan 2026
recent_changes.impact: Positive: removes the provincial attestation step and cap competition for master's at public universities (all six programmes here). Private-institution master's still need a PAL/TAL. Quebec still needs a CAQ.

recent_changes.title: Proof-of-funds living-cost amount raised to CAD 23,448/year
recent_changes.who_affected: Study permit applicants outside Quebec applying on or after 1 Sept 2026
recent_changes.impact: More cash must be shown upfront (on top of first-year tuition), raising the loan/GIC amount an Indian family must arrange.

recent_changes.title: Spousal open work permits limited (master's must be 16+ months)
recent_changes.impact: Spouse can only get an open work permit if the student is in a master's of 16 months or longer, a doctorate, or a listed professional degree. 10-12 month master's (UBC MDS, TMU, Ivey) give no spousal work rights, so a couple loses a second income.

recent_changes.title: PGWP language requirement (CLB 7 for university grads) and field-of-study rules
recent_changes.who_affected: PGWP applicants applying on or after 1 Nov 2024; field-of-study rule does not apply to master's graduates
recent_changes.impact: Master's graduates must prove CLB 7 in all four skills to get the PGWP; field-of-study restriction does not apply to them. Keep a valid language test at graduation.

recent_changes.title: Student Direct Stream (SDS) ended
recent_changes.who_affected: Applicants from India and other SDS countries
recent_changes.impact: No fast-track stream for Indian students; all apply via the regular study permit stream (GICs still accepted as proof of funds). Expect standard processing times.

recent_changes.title: Study permit compliance guidance tightened (leave, transfers, completion date)
recent_changes.who_affected: Current and future study permit holders
recent_changes.impact: No work during any leave from studies; changing institution needs a new study permit; repeated leaves can be judged non-compliance. Raises the cost of taking a break. Secondary source (ICEF Monitor) summarising IRCC operational guidance.

recent_changes.title: PGWP field-of-study list frozen for 2026
recent_changes.impact: No direct impact on master's students. Secondary source (CIC News); review of the list may bring changes for 2027.

policy_volatility.evidence: Since late 2024 Canada ended SDS, added PGWP language/field rules, restricted spousal work permits, cut the study permit cap again for 2026 (7% below 2025, 16% below 2024), raised proof of funds, and tightened compliance guidance in June 2026.

psw_uncertainty.evidence: Master's graduates get an open PGWP of up to 3 years with no field-of-study restriction (IRCC), but must meet CLB 7, and the government is actively shrinking the temporary resident population.

work_restrictions.evidence: 24 hours/week off-campus during term, unlimited in scheduled breaks; PGWP is fully open. Student-period and co-op work do not count toward CEC, and no work is allowed during leave.

funds_burden.evidence: Must show CAD 23,448/year living funds plus first-year tuition (e.g. ~CAD 45,000 for Concordia MACS year 1, ~CAD 160,000 for Ivey) before the visa.

recent_adverse.evidence: Last 12 months: lower 2026 cap, higher proof-of-funds from Sept 2026, stricter compliance rules; offset by the 2026 PAL/TAL exemption for master's at public universities.

tax.basis: Estimate, computed by us for a single Ontario employee at CAD ~100,000 using official 2026 CRA rates: federal brackets (14% to 58,523; 20.5% to 117,045...), Ontario brackets (5.05% to 53,891; 9.15% to 107,785...), CPP 5.95% on 3,500-74,600, EI 1.63% to 68,900. Federal BPA 16,452 and Ontario BPA 12,989 are from secondary sources; CPP2 (4% on 74,600-85,000) from secondary sources. Result: ~21% at CAD 63,000, ~24% at 80,000, ~25% at 100,000. Excludes Ontario Health Premium and Ontario surtax (roughly +1 percentage point) and the Canada employment amount.

checklist: Choose a master's at a public DLI that is PGWP-eligible; check whether it is 16+ months if your spouse needs to work.
Get the admission letter; master's at public DLIs need no PAL/TAL from 1 Jan 2026 (private institutions still do).
For Quebec (e.g. Concordia), apply for the CAQ first; it is needed before the study permit.
Arrange proof of funds: first-year tuition plus CAD 23,448 living costs (outside Quebec), e.g. a GIC plus education loan sanction and bank statements.
Take IELTS/PTE/CELPIP now and aim for CLB 7 in all four skills, which you will also need for the PGWP.
Apply online for the regular study permit (SDS ended Nov 2024); fee CAD 150.
Give biometrics at a visa application centre after receiving the instruction letter (CAD 85).
Do the immigration medical exam with an IRCC panel physician if IRCC asks for one.
On arrival, keep full-time status, work at most 24 h/week off-campus in term, and never work during leave.
Within 180 days of finishing, apply for the PGWP (up to 3 years); then build 1 year of skilled work for Express Entry CEC.
